retrievalProfile.description: A central group of figures framed by concentric spirals of repeating text against a dark, textured background.
triggerTerms: urban group portrait with circular typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A central trio of figures in 90s urban attire (denim, crop tops) positioned within a dark void, surrounded by multiple layers of text that spiral outward from the center, creating a sense of depth and motion.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric text spirals framing a central subject
High contrast between bright subjects and dark background
Repetition of subject silhouettes in the background texture
Dynamic diagonal posing of central figures
coreInvariants: Dark, vignetted background with ghosted repetitions of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three central figures occupy the middle 50% of the frame, scaled to appear as the primary focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the light-colored top and denim jeans.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the spiral text from the top right, circling inward toward the central group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, textured negative space in the corners to emphasize the circular motion.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light blue denim and white text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and mustard yellow highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subjects and the void; muted saturation typical of 90s print.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to denim blues, warm yellows, and monochromatic darks

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes

composition.scale: Large at top, decreasing as it spirals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying scales and path orientations to create rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, friendly geometric terminals and 90s pop aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric structure with soft corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of three people in 90s urban streetwear (denim, crop tops) against a dark, textured black background with faint, ghosted repetitions of their silhouettes in the shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, rounded geometric sans-serif font in white. Set the text on a spiral path that starts large at the top right and winds inward toward the center.

verificationChecks: Text follows a clear spiral path
Color palette is dominated by denim blue and dark tones

mustRedesign: Avoid modern high-definition digital clarity; maintain a slightly grainy, film-like texture.
postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible along the curve?
Does the spiral draw the eye to the center?
Is the 90s urban aesthetic preserved in the clothing?
Are the background 'ghost' figures subtle enough?
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Concentric spiral typography + Dark textured void + Ghosted background elements
